name: Tachibana Maria
source:
Maria is the mother of  Ritsuka and Lindo.

After her husband mysteriously disappeared, Maria was left to raise her children, Ritsuka and Lindo, by herself.

She is a kind and caring mother who worries a lot about her daughter.
